title.after: 利用RouterOS（CVE-2022-34960）漏洞，将符号链接作为挂载入口获取代码执行

note: 官方记录将 RouterOS 7.4beta4 容器挂载符号链接问题归于 CVE-2022-34960。CVE-2022-3496 实际属于 SourceCodester Human Resource Management System 的访问控制问题，已从本页主编号移入历史引用。显示标题同步更正；旧路径、旧 cve 字段与历史原文保留。

descriptions.value: The container package in MikroTik RouterOS 7.4beta4 allows an attacker to create mount points pointing to symbolic links, which resolve to locations on the host device. This allows the attacker to mount any arbitrary file to any location on the host.

A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Human Resource Management System 1.0 and classified as critical. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file employeeadd.php of the component Admin Panel. The manipulation leads to improper access controls. The attack may be initiated remotely. The identifier VDB-210785 was assigned to this vulnerability.
